description: Hash-anchored source extracts for class-based NPC creation (NPC_MODE_PLAN.md Phase 0). Anchors the local Core Rulebook excerpt and official Archives of Nethys snapshots, curates fragments consumed by the NPC catalog builders, and records the remaining source gaps.

extraction.note: Extract line ranges are stable because every parent file and derived text file is immutable and hash-anchored. Downstream code does not fetch live web pages or re-run PDF extraction.

core-rulebook-pdf.description: 16-page Core Rulebook PDF excerpt: complete class spell lists (Bard 0-6, Cleric 0-9, Druid 0-9, Paladin 1-4, Ranger 1-4, Sorcerer/Wizard 0-9) plus the first alphabetical spell descriptions. This is the ONLY local Core Rulebook content; NPC creation pages 448-454, races, class tables, skills, feats, equipment, and Appendix gear tables are not present.

core-rulebook-txt-legacy.description: Existing 1749-line extraction of the 16-page spell excerpt; anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-core-txt. Must not be modified.

pathfinder-unchained-txt.description: Existing full Simple Monster Creation chapter (5566 lines); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-unchained-txt. Must not be modified.

bestiary-txt.description: Existing 2-page Bestiary appendix: Table 1-1 (Monster Statistics by CR) and Table 1-2 (Creature Hit Dice by CR); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as bestiary-txt.

core-rulebook-extract.contents: Complete spell-list chapter for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), followed by the opening of the alphabetical spell descriptions (roughly the letter A: Acid Fog, Acid Splash, Air Walker, Astral Projection, Energy Drain, Etherealness, Shapechange, Soul Bind, Time Stop, Wail of the Banshee, Wish). Two-column PDF; reading order is reliable in the list section, partially scrambled in the description section.
core-rulebook-extract.catalogUse: NPC spell lists (adept = cleric/druid lists; PC casters) for tasks 3.b and 5.a.

core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.contents: Spell-list portion only: complete class lists for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), and Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), ending immediately before the alphabetical spell-description section. Two-column extraction losses: the cleric 7th-level and druid 3rd-level lists are empty in the excerpt at page boundaries; the parser records these as emptySections.
core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.catalogUse: Stable parse target for spell list membership in the NPC catalog (tools/parse_npc_sources.py).
